import pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792484937/attempts/902a26a1d741414098c8ca31bef93000/system/state/workspace/programs/task-0c3988ec.py')
code='''def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    bg=max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v:sum(r.count(v) for r in grid))
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]!=bg]
    from collections import Counter
    counts=Counter(grid[r][c] for r,c in pts)
    # Continue any diagonal two-or-more-cell object along its established direction.
    for color,n in counts.items():
        ps=[(r,c) for r,c in pts if grid[r][c]==color]
        for dr in (-1,1):
            for dc in (-1,1):
                for r,c in ps:
                    if (r-dr,c-dc) in ps:
                        rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
                        while 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w:
                            if out[rr][cc]==bg: out[rr][cc]=color
                            rr+=dr;cc+=dc
    return out
'''
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);p.write_text(code)
